pluginText.pf.license: {"need":"always, to carry paying passengers: each captain holds the federal captain's license for the boat's waters and passenger count (a 6-passenger license for an uninspected boat, a master's license for an inspected boat), with the drug-testing program and medical certificate it requires; the business holds any charter or fishing guide license where the state's rules require one; each boat has its own registration or federal documentation, and an inspected boat its certificate of inspection","who":"each captain, for their license, drug-testing enrollment and medical certificate; the business, for any state charter or guide license; each boat, for its own papers","ask":"the business registration and any state charter or guide license; each captain's license number, its passenger limit and end date; each boat's registration or documentation number, its passenger limit, and for an inspected boat its certificate of inspection","check":"none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie","scope":"a captain is offered only for boats and passenger counts their license covers","blocks":"a boat goes live only with a licensed captain on file and its own papers in date; the business only with its state charter license where the state requires one","renewals":"optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)","insurance":"liability and boat insurance, shown only once proof is sent","how it's checked":"Not checked by Rosie. Each captain's federal license, the boat's papers and the inspection certificate are the owner's own, shown as given (D96)."}

pluginText.pf.questions: {"beforeTimes":["a private boat, or a seat on a shared trip","how many people in all, adults and children (sets the price and must fit the boat's limit)","inshore or offshore, and the date","for a pick-up: the kind of place (a home dock or a hotel marina) and the town"],"afterTime":["anything the captain should know: first time on a boat, a target fish, a celebration","who will fish, and the children's ages"],"securePage":["each passenger's name for the passenger list, and an emergency contact on shore","each passenger's waiver, signed by that passenger, or by a parent or guardian for a child","each angler's fishing license number where the boat's license doesn't cover its passengers","health details a passenger wants the captain to know (a heart condition, pregnancy, a recent surgery, trouble climbing)","for a pick-up: the dock's street address and how to reach it"],"whoMayBook":"an adult books for the group; children come with an adult from the group, who stays on board with them","told":"be at the slip 30 minutes before the trip; the boat's rules (no glass, soft-soled shoes, alcohol only as the captain allows); the captain makes the weather call; the boat waits 15 minutes for a late group"}
pluginText.pf.safety: {"stop":[{"words":"someone overboard or a boat in trouble on the water right now","say":"Call 911, or the Coast Guard on VHF channel 16 if you're on the water.","booking":"no booking"},{"words":"someone unwell right now: chest pain, trouble breathing, a bad fall","say":"Call 911 now.","booking":"no booking"}],"goOn":[{"words":"pregnant, a heart condition, a recent surgery, trouble walking or climbing","what":"the booking goes on; the captain reads the private note before the trip and may say the trip isn't safe for that person; Rosie gives no health advice"},{"words":"seasickness","what":"the booking goes on; the reminder suggests asking a pharmacist or doctor about seasickness options ahead of time"}],"boarding":"a passenger who seems drunk or high, or won't follow the captain's safety rules, doesn't board; the captain's word is final, and the rest of the group's trip goes on","onTheWater":"a safety talk before leaving; life jackets for everyone, and children wear theirs as the federal rules require; an emergency on the water: the captain calls the Coast Guard first, then Sam is told","weather":"the captain makes the go or no-go call from the marine forecast for the waters fished (wind, waves, a small craft advisory, lightning), the evening before and again at the dock; a trip can turn back early for safety"}
pluginText.pf.first_steps: {"steps":["each passenger's waiver on the secure page before the trip (a parent or guardian signs for a child), good for the season","the passenger list (names and a shore contact) on the secure page by 6pm the evening before","fishing licenses: where the boat's license doesn't cover its passengers, each angler who needs one buys it before the trip, and the number goes on the secure page"],"prep":"at the slip 30 minutes early; soft-soled shoes, layers, sunscreen and a hat; food and drinks in a soft cooler, no glass; ask a pharmacist about seasickness options ahead of time; fishing licenses where needed"}
pluginText.pf.visit: {"checkIn":"at the slip the captain or mate takes the booker's code, checks the passenger list against who's there, and counts heads against the boat's limit","grace":"the boat waits 15 minutes for a late group, then may leave; a private trip still ends at its set time","changes":"fish cleaning or an extra hour is priced first and the group says yes; an extra hour only if the next trip allows","endEarly":"a trip the group asks to end early (seasick, cold) is the full price; a trip the captain turns back for weather or a boat problem follows the captain's terms: back within half the trip time, a free rain check or half the price back","done":"the captain texts DONE back at the dock; the rest is paid there"}
pluginText.pf.money: {"before":"a deposit holds a private trip (about 25%); a shared seat is paid in full","after":"the rest paid at the dock before leaving (card, cash or check, the business's own way), or charged to the saved card at DONE for a pick-up trip","cancel":"free to cancel up to 72 hours before; later, the deposit may be kept, only with Sam's yes; the captain's weather call: a full refund or a new date, the group picks","groupPays":"one person books and pays the deposit; at the dock the group pays the rest together, or splits it, the business's own way","tips":"a tip for the crew is the group's choice, in cash at the dock; Rosie never asks","caps":"deposits within the state's limits where they apply","tax":"where the state taxes charters","fee2":"Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies: one $2 per trip, however many on board"}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never":"passengers' health details, shore contacts, fishing license numbers and dates of birth: only on the secure page","staffTexts":"the captain's day list shows the booker's name and the number on board; the passenger list opens only on the captain's signed-in phone","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"texts go to the adult who booked"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"licenses":"each captain's federal license for the boat and passenger count, with drug testing and a medical certificate; a mate needs no license unless the boat's papers require a licensed crew","skills":"which boats each captain may run; inshore, offshore, fly fishing","crews":"a 6-passenger trip: a captain, with a mate on full days; an inspected boat: the crew its certificate requires","standIn":"another captain licensed and insured for that boat and passenger count; a group that asked for a captain by name is asked first, and nobody moves on silence","oks":"Sam OKs refunds, rain checks and extra hours past the trip time"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"passengers":"never more passengers than the boat's papers and the captain's license allow","safety":"life jackets for everyone on board; children wear theirs as the rules require; a safety talk before leaving","fishing":"fishing licenses, catch limits and seasons follow the rules of the waters fished; the captain decides what's kept; Rosie never promises a catch","alcohol":"only as the captain allows; no glass","records":"the passenger list for each trip kept with the booking for 7 years","cancelRight":"no cancel period for time on the water already given","reviews":"a rating once after the trip"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"weatherCall":"the captain calls it the evening before or at the dock from the marine forecast: the group gets a new date or a full refund","turnBack":"the captain turns back for weather or a boat problem: back within half the trip time, a free rain check or half back; later than that, Sam decides","endEarly":"the group asks to come in early: the full price","boatOut":"a boat problem before the trip: another boat that fits, a new date, or a full refund","captainOut":"another licensed captain for that boat; a group that named a captain is asked first; nobody moves on silence","tooMany":"more people at the dock than the boat may carry: only up to the limit board","impaired":"a passenger who seems drunk doesn't board; the group's trip goes on without them; no refund for that person","noLicense":"an angler without a needed fishing license can ride along but not fish; the trip goes on","minors":"children with an adult from the group, in a life jacket","other":"all other edge cases the generic way"}
